note: Re-judged 2026-10-26 at HEAD 4741b4f68f (independent judge, clean clone), after 5b76639f4a and 051333ec73. Upgraded from weak: the units changed (two new tagged units, claim and prose edits), so this is a fresh judgement, not an upgrade over unchanged units. Section 2.20: "An IKE implementation MAY decline to give out version information prior to authentication or even after authentication in case some implementation is known to have some security weakness.  In that case, it MUST either return an empty string or no CP payload if CP is not supported." The weak finding is closed: rfc7296_cp_version_reply_test.go drives a pool-bound peer's real IKE_AUTH responder; positive TestRFC7296GrantedVersionRequestIsAnsweredEmpty asserts exactly one zero-length APPLICATION_VERSION in the CFG_REPLY (mutant cp.go:476 grant.req.appVersion -> false, verified red), negative TestRFC7296GrantedVersionRequestReflectsNoVersionString sends "strongSwan 6.0.1" and asserts one INTERNAL_IP4_ADDRESS plus exactly one zero-length APPLICATION_VERSION (mutant cp.go:477 Value []byte("ze"), verified red). That is the empty-string form where Ze supports CP. The no-CP form stays proven for a peer bound to no pool in IKE_AUTH (TestRFC7296ResponderAnswersAVersionRequestWithNoCP, revert of handleAuthRequest) and in INFORMATIONAL (two tests, reverts of mobikeResponsePayloads); TestZeDeclinesApplicationVersion's positive claim now states only what builtCPSweep checks. Seven records, none stale. Reading taken: Ze processes CP only in IKE_AUTH (decideCPRequest callers are responder.go and responder_eap.go only), so in INFORMATIONAL CP is not supported for any peer and no CP payload is the right form, which matches RFC 7296 Section 3.15.4 "If the responder does not support Configuration payloads at all, it can simply ignore all Configuration payloads." A pool-bound peer's INFORMATIONAL version request has no tagged test; under a strict reading that ties the no-CP form to global CP support it would owe the empty string, so name it if the owner reads it so. Residual weaknesses that do not change the verdict: TestZeDeclinesApplicationVersion's negative half is a codec round trip that violates nothing, and the two reply tests carry the real negative. Stale comment: rfc7296_cp_version_informational_test.go still says 'Ze, which supports no CP' in TestRFC7296InformationalVersionRequestDrawsNoCP's Goal comment; the true statement is that Ze answers no CP in INFORMATIONAL.
